## 1. Intra-class correlations (classid)
```{r icc}
# binary outcomes: latent-scale ICC = tau2 / (tau2 + pi^2/3); continuous: tau2 / (tau2 + sigma2)
icc_bin  <- function(y) { f <- glmer(reformulate("(1 | classid)", y), g9, family = binomial)
  t2 <- as.numeric(VarCorr(f)$classid); t2 / (t2 + pi^2 / 3) }
icc_cont <- function(y) { f <- lmer(reformulate("(1 | classid)", y), g9)
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(f)); vc$vcov[1] / sum(vc$vcov) }

bin_y  <- c("prop_any","viol_any","oth_any","serious_any","download_any")
cont_y <- c("off_vers","NTS_prof","NTS_shop","LEG","PJ","EFF","MOR","SC",
            "SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","FAMB","SCHB","PEERD")
icc <- bind_rows(
  tibble(variable = bin_y,  type = "binary (latent)", icc = map_dbl(bin_y,  icc_bin)),
  tibble(variable = cont_y, type = "continuous",      icc = map_dbl(cont_y, icc_cont))) |>
  mutate(icc = round(icc, 3))
icc
```

## 2. Prevalence by gender
```{r prevalence}
prev <- g9 |> filter(!is.na(male)) |>
  group_by(sex = if_else(male == 1, "boys", "girls")) |>
  summarise(n = n(), across(all_of(bin_y), \(x) sum(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_n"),
            across(all_of(bin_y), \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), .names = "{.col}_pct"))
prev
```

## 3. Correlations among predictors
```{r correlations}
preds <- c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_prof","NTS_shop","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt",
           "SHAME_arrest","SC","FAMB","SCHB","PEERD","male","deprfam")
cor_m <- round(cor(g9[preds], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), 2)
cor_m
```

## 4. Missingness patterns
```{r missing}
model_vars <- c("off_vers","LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_prof","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt",
                "SC","male","deprfam","SCHB","PEERD")
g9$n_miss  <- rowSums(is.na(g9[model_vars]))
g9$complete <- as.integer(g9$n_miss == 0)

miss <- tibble(
  stat  = c("complete cases", "cases missing 1", "cases missing 2+",
            "offending (off_vers) complete vs incomplete", "male % complete vs incomplete",
            "family bond missing: father item blank", "family bond missing: mother item blank"),
  value = c(sum(g9$complete), sum(g9$n_miss == 1), sum(g9$n_miss >= 2),
            sprintf("%.2f vs %.2f", mean(g9$off_vers[g9$complete == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
                                    mean(g9$off_vers[g9$complete == 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
            sprintf("%.1f vs %.1f", 100 * mean(g9$male[g9$complete == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
                                    100 * mean(g9$male[g9$complete == 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
            sum(is.na(g9$FAMB) & is.na(g9$fambond1)), sum(is.na(g9$FAMB) & is.na(g9$fambond2))))
miss
```


## Honesty checks and crosswise estimate (Methods, measurement of offending)
```{r crosswise}
library(survey)
ist <- read_rds(here("data", "processed", "isrd3_istanbul.rds"))
an  <- read_rds(here("data", "processed", "isrd3_g9_analysis.rds"))
g9_all <- ist |> filter(num(grade) == 9)                       # all grade 9, before screening

# 1. Relevin and non-disclosure: all grade 9 (Relevin was one of the screening flags)
honesty <- g9_all |> summarise(
  n            = n(),
  relevin_n    = sum(num(releltp) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  relevin_pct  = 100 * mean(num(releltp) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  nondisc_n    = sum(num(openness) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  nondisc_pct  = 100 * mean(num(openness) == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
honesty_screened <- g9_all |> filter(caseid %in% an$caseid) |>
  summarise(n = n(), nondisc_pct = 100 * mean(num(openness) == 1, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Crosswise estimate: screened sample, students who answered the crosswise item
cw <- g9_all |> filter(caseid %in% an$caseid, !is.na(crossov)) |>
  mutate(B      = as.numeric(num(crossov) == 2),              # 2 = answers differ
         direct = as.numeric(rowSums(across(c(shoplyp, extolyp, asltlyp, burglyp),
                                            \(x) num(x) > 0), na.rm = TRUE) > 0))
des <- svydesign(ids = ~classid, data = cw)                   # SEs allow for clustering in classes

cw_est <- function(p) {
  lam <- svymean(~B, des); l <- coef(lam); se_l <- SE(lam)
  pi  <- (l - p) / (1 - 2 * p); se <- se_l / abs(1 - 2 * p)
  tibble(p = p, n = nrow(cw), lambda = l, est = 100 * pi,
         lo = 100 * (pi - 1.96 * se), hi = 100 * (pi + 1.96 * se))
}
dir <- svymean(~direct, des)
crosswise <- bind_rows(cw_est(.25), cw_est(.30)) |>
  mutate(direct = 100 * coef(dir), direct_lo = 100 * (coef(dir) - 1.96 * SE(dir)),
         direct_hi = 100 * (coef(dir) + 1.96 * SE(dir)))

write_csv(mutate(honesty, across(where(is.numeric), \(v) round(v, 2))),
          here("output", "tables", "honesty_checks_v2.csv"))
write_csv(mutate(crosswise, across(where(is.numeric), \(v) round(v, 2))),
          here("output", "tables", "crosswise_v2.csv"))
honesty; honesty_screened; crosswise
```
